serviceParameters.label: Databricks Workspace Profile
serviceParameters.description: Profile name from .databrickscfg (e.g. 'WORKSPACE_A'). Optional — falls back to env-var-based default. Determines which Databricks workspace this service connects to.

serviceParameters.label: SQL Warehouse HTTP Path
serviceParameters.description: Databricks SQL Warehouse HTTP path (e.g. /sql/1.0/warehouses/abc123). Lakehouse services only. Optional — defaults to DATABRICKS_HTTP_PATH env var.

serviceParameters.label: Table Name
serviceParameters.description: Fully qualified Databricks table name (catalog.schema.table). Used for read-only services.

serviceParameters.label: Geometry Column
serviceParameters.description: Name of the geometry column in the table

serviceParameters.label: ID Field
serviceParameters.description: Name of the unique identifier field (optional, defaults to 'id')

serviceParameters.label: Geometry Format
serviceParameters.description: Storage format of the geometry column: WKT, WKB, GEOJSON, or GEOMETRY (optional, auto-detected from column name if not set)

serviceParameters.label: Time Column
serviceParameters.description: Name of the timestamp column for time filtering (optional)

serviceParameters.label: Lakebase Host
serviceParameters.description: Lakebase (PostgreSQL) hostname. When set, routes reads and writes through Lakebase for editing support.

serviceParameters.label: Lakebase Table
serviceParameters.description: Table name in Lakebase for reads and writes

serviceParameters.label: Max Record Count
serviceParameters.description: Maximum features returned per page (default: 2000). Clients can request fewer via resultRecordCount.

serviceParameters.label: Spatial Reference ID
serviceParameters.description: EPSG SRID of the geometry column (default: 4326 / WGS 84)

serviceParameters.label: Editing Enabled
serviceParameters.description: Set to 'true' to enable feature editing via applyEdits (Lakebase only). Also requires capabilities: 'Query,Editing' on the service.
